correctness.rationale: The implicit circle equation and polar-cell partition prove exact boundary radius, monotonicities and the finite-n weighted area identity. The identity -rho*rho_c=d_t(rho*sin t) gives the derivative and its unique strict sign change. Uniform c1-c0=O(h²) bounds control all Taylor remainders, yielding both n^-2 coefficients with O(n^-4) errors. A separate standard-library numerical check samples various radii and weights; it is not invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Weighted disk-polygonal deviation is explicitly motivated by Basit–Lángi open Problems 2–3. This result computes an exact nontrivial symmetry-preserving benchmark within that hard problem, including an interior unique optimum, weight-continuous interpolation and a sharp curvature-dependent error constant. It does not assert a global downstream theorem or rely on an arbitrary finite slice.
